summary: iRedMail is a complete email server solution built around standard components like Postfix and Dovecot. It automates the complex configuration required to run a self-hosted mail transfer agent, handling inbound and outbound mail routing, storage, and retrieval.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators who want to set up an independent mail infrastructure using well-established Linux mail components without manually configuring every underlying service.
watchOut: Managing a self-hosted mail server carries a heavy operational burden regarding IP reputation, spam filtering, and DNS records such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Additionally, the low maintenance health score suggests you should carefully evaluate its long-term viability before committing.
deployNotes: Because it is deployed via shell scripts, you typically need a clean, dedicated server installation to avoid conflicting with existing web services or mail daemons. You will also need to ensure persistent storage is available for mail spools and databases.
